Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

School & learning · Civic life: news, government & the law

culture noun

learning and the arts; being cultured

also cultured, cultivated, the arts, liberal arts, refinement, a person of culture

classical

Cic. Arch. 2: omnēs artēs, quae ad hūmānitātem pertinent
Cic. Fam. 11.27.6: lepōs, hūmānitās, litterae
Traupman 151, 299: culture

hūmānitās, hūmānitātis f.

noun, third declension

culture, refinement: the learning and manners that make a person humane

Lewis & Short: mental cultivation befitting a man, liberal education, good breeding, refinement. It also means kindness and human feeling; the context decides. For a people’s civilisation see culture, a people’s way of life.

Other words

  • litterae, litterārum f. pl. — learning, letters: culture from reading

    noun, first declension, plural · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 11.27.6: lepōs, hūmānitās, litterae; M-O s.v. civilized: culture: literary culture

    Morgan–Owens’s word for literary culture, from Cicero.

  • cultūra animī — the cultivation of the mind

    phrase · also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 2.13: cultūra autem animī philosophia est; Hor. Ep. 1.1.40: sī modo cultūrae patientem commodet aurem

    Cicero’s metaphor from farming; Horace uses cultūra alone for it. By itself the word is above all the tilling of land (agrī cultūra), not a people’s culture.

Examples

  • Etenim omnēs artēs, quae ad hūmānitātem pertinent, habent quoddam commūne vinculum, et quasi cognātiōne quādam inter sē continentur.

    For all the arts that belong to culture share a common bond, and are held together by a kind of kinship.Cic. Arch. 2

  • adde quod ingenuās didicisse fidēliter artēs ēmollit mōrēs nec sinit esse ferōs

    besides, to have studied the liberal arts faithfully softens one’s ways and keeps them from being wildOv. Pont. 2.9.47–48

  • nēmō adeō ferus est, ut nōn mītēscere possit, sī modo cultūrae patientem commodet aurem

    no one is so wild that he cannot be tamed, if only he lends a patient ear to cultivationHor. Ep. 1.1.39–40

See also culture, learn, book, music.
